description: This file contains unit tests for Rust target functions within a build system, specifically testing crate name, crate root, crate type, configuration propagation, defaults, and dependencies in a Chromium-based project.

classes.name: RustFunctionsTarget
classes.description: Type alias for TestWithScheduler, used as a test fixture for Rust target function tests.

methods.name: CrateName
methods.description: Test that the crate name is correctly set based on input.

methods.name: CrateRootFind
methods.description: Test that the crate root is correctly identified based on source files and target type.

methods.name: CrateTypeSelection
methods.description: Test that the crate type (dylib, rlib) is correctly selected and validated.

methods.name: ConfigValues
methods.description: Test that configuration values like rustflags and rustenv are propagated.

methods.name: SetDefaults
methods.description: Test that default target settings are correctly applied.

methods.name: PublicConfigs
methods.description: Test that public configs are correctly handled.
